name_note: The GTDB genus Ellagibacter is broader than the published description, holding several additional uncultured species alongside the described Ellagibacter isourolithinifaciens.

sentences.text: Ellagibacter is a genus of the family Eggerthellaceae, proposed for a strictly anaerobic, Gram-stain-positive bacterium isolated from healthy human faeces.
The genus was proposed with a single species, Ellagibacter isourolithinifaciens, reported to metabolise ellagic acid into isourolithin A.

A study reported that Ellagibacter isourolithinifaciens and Gordonibacter urolithinfaciens convert ellagic acid into urolithins, and also metabolise caffeic, dihydrocaffeic, rosmarinic and chlorogenic acids.
In 752 participants with type 2 diabetes, a study reported Ellagibacter isourolithinifaciens among three gut species associated with albuminuria.
